sql.query: SELECT rp.id grantId FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=utr.roleId INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='tenant.users.view' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:actor AND utr.tenantId=:tenantId AND utr.isActive=1 LIMIT 1
SELECT ut.positionLevel,ut.reportsToUserId,u.jobTitle FROM tbl_user_tenants ut INNER JOIN tbl_users u ON u.id=ut.userId WHERE ut.tenantId=:tenantId AND ut.userId=:userId AND :allowed>0 LIMIT 1

SELECT u.id userId,CONCAT(COALESCE(NULLIF(u.displayName,''),u.email),' — ',REPLACE(ut.positionLevel,'_',' ')) managerLabel FROM tbl_user_tenants ut INNER JOIN tbl_users u ON u.id=ut.userId AND u.isActive=1 WHERE ut.tenantId=:tenantId AND ut.isActive=1 AND ut.membershipStatus='active' AND ut.userId<>:userId AND :allowed>0 ORDER BY FIELD(ut.positionLevel,'executive','director','manager','team_member'),u.displayName
